paper_title: Compact Attention: Exploiting Structured Spatio-Temporal Sparsity for Fast Video Generation
original_abstract: The computational demands of self-attention mechanisms pose a critical challenge for transformer-based video generation, particularly in synthesizing ultra-long sequences. Current approaches, such as factorized attention and fixed sparse patterns, fail to fully exploit the inherent spatio-temporal redundancies in video data. Through systematic analysis of video diffusion transformers (DiT), we uncover a key insight: Attention matrices exhibit structured, yet heterogeneous sparsity patterns, where specialized heads dynamically attend to distinct spatiotemporal regions (e.g., local pattern, cross-shaped pattern, or global pattern). Existing sparse attention methods either impose rigid constraints or introduce significant overhead, limiting their effectiveness. To address this, we propose Compact Attention, a hardware-aware acceleration framework featuring three innovations: 1) Adaptive tiling strategies that approximate diverse spatial interaction patterns via dynamic tile grouping, 2) Temporally varying windows that adjust sparsity levels based on frame proximity, and 3) An automated configuration search algorithm that optimizes sparse patterns while preserving critical attention pathways. Our method achieves 1.6∼2.5×acceleration in attention computation on single-GPU setups while maintaining comparable visual quality with full-attention baselines. This work provides a principled approach to unlocking efficient long-form video generation through structured sparsity exploitation.

innovative_points.name: Structured Sparsity Discovery
innovative_points.description: Systematic identification of heterogeneous spatio-temporal attention patterns in video diffusion transformers
innovative_points.technical_details: Discovered three spatial patterns (local, cross-shaped, global) and two temporal patterns (time-variant, time-invariant) through per-query-token attention analysis
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Enables offline mask pre-computation, reducing runtime overhead from pattern discovery

innovative_points.name: Tile-Based Deformable Sparse Pattern
innovative_points.description: Hierarchical grouping mechanism that respects video's dual nature (temporal variation and spatial locality)
innovative_points.technical_details: Reorganizes tokens into spacetime tiles with frame-group-wise patterns and dual attention windows
innovative_points.runtime_representation: [N, k, d] where k = (1-sparsity)×N, with tile-level processing maintaining hardware efficiency

innovative_points.name: Optimized Auto-Search Algorithm
innovative_points.description: Offline configuration pipeline with dual-threshold boundary contraction for mask optimization
innovative_points.technical_details: Uses recall threshold τ and cost threshold λ with conservative union merging across prompts
innovative_points.runtime_representation: One-time offline cost: [H, L, T] where H=heads, L=layers, T=timesteps; Runtime: O(1) mask loading

innovative_points.name: Pattern Stability Analysis
innovative_points.description: Demonstration that attention patterns are input-invariant and temporally robust
innovative_points.technical_details: Similarity > 0.8 across prompts/seeds, stable within denoising step ranges
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Enables reliable offline pre-computation and mask reuse across n consecutive steps

improvements.name: Adaptive Dynamic Patterns (ADP)
improvements.description: Real-time pattern adaptation based on content entropy analysis
improvements.technical_implementation: Compute per-tile entropy during inference, dynamically adjust mask boundaries ±10%
improvements.runtime_representation: [N, k_adaptive, d] where k_adaptive = k × (1 + α×entropy)

improvements.name: Hierarchical Threshold Learning (HTL)
improvements.description: Learn head-specific thresholds using reinforcement learning
improvements.technical_implementation: Lightweight MLP predicts optimal τ, λ per head with quality×log(speedup) reward
improvements.runtime_representation: Additional [H, 2] computation where H = number of heads

improvements.name: Progressive Early Denoising (PED)
improvements.description: Gradual sparsity increase based on denoising progress
improvements.technical_implementation: Start 10% sparsity at step 0, linear increase to final sparsity by step 15
improvements.runtime_representation: Progressive reduction from [N, 0.9N, d] to [N, k, d]

improvements.name: Multi-Scale Tile Hierarchy (MTH)
improvements.description: Hierarchical tiles with adaptive resolution for multi-scale patterns
improvements.technical_implementation: Three scales: 8×8, 16×16, 32×32 tiles with scale selection based on pattern type
improvements.runtime_representation: Memory: O(N log N) vs O(N) baseline

improvements.name: Cross-Model Pattern Transfer (CMPT)
improvements.description: Transfer learned patterns across similar architectures
improvements.technical_implementation: Meta-learning approach with 10% of original search cost per new model
improvements.runtime_representation: Transfer computation: [M, M', H] where M, M' = model dimensions
